detail: BanknoteNews entry for Rwanda's new 2,000-franc note (B143a), introduced 03.09.2024, carries the field 'Printer: (De La Rue)'.
BanknoteNews entry for Mongolia's new 5,000-togrog note (B445a), dated 2024, reads 'Printer: (Giesecke & Devrient). 152 x 72 mm. Paper.' No introduction date is stated; the post is dated 2024-12-16.

BanknoteNews entry for Namibia's new 50-dollar note (B222a) of the upgraded series carries the field 'Printer: (De La Rue)'. This is the printer field, not the substrate line; the entry's substrate line reads '140 x 70 mm. Paper.' No introduction date is stated.
BanknoteNews entry for Malawi's new 2,000-kwacha note (B164a), introduced 24.02.2022, reads 'Printer: (Giesecke & Devrient)'.
BanknoteNews entry for the Bahamas' new 1-dollar note (B357a), introduced 03.02.2025, names Giesecke + Devrient in its 'Printer:' field.
BanknoteNews entry for Suriname's new 500-dollar note (B552), introduced 23.03.2024, reads 'Printer: GD'.
BanknoteNews entry for Belize's new 100-dollar note (B336a), introduced 04.08.2025, reads 'Printer: (De La Rue)'.
BanknoteNews entry for Barbados' new 50-dollar polymer note (B243), introduced 05.12.2022, names DE LA RUE in its 'Printer:' field.

BanknoteNews entry for Mozambique's new 500-metical note (B244a), dated 16 June 2024 on the note, reads 'Printer: (Crane Currency).' This is the printer field, not a substrate claim; the entry's substrate line reads 'Paper.' No introduction date is stated; the post is dated 2024-07-09.
BanknoteNews entry for Sao Tome and Principe's new 50-dobra commemorative note (BNP317), introduced 26.08.2026, reads 'Printer: (Royal Joh. Enschedé)'. Commemorative note.
source_title: Sao Tome and Principe new 50-dobra commemorative note (B316a) confirmed

detail: Times of Central Asia, 25 March 2025: 'The new notes are produced by the Bishkek-based Open Joint Stock Company Uchkun.' The National Bank chairman announced that domestic production had begun with small denominations. The article does not state who owns Uchkun.
source_title: Kyrgyzstan Begins Domestic Printing of National Currency Banknotes

detail: Banca d'Italia's own technical-cooperation page for an October 2023 seminar is titled 'Banknote production at Banca d'Italia. Quality, environment, safety and security in the printing process' and describes the bank's Banknote Service (Servizio Banconote) and the printing phases of production. The page names no separate printing-works entity, and no euro allocation figures are given.
source_title: Banknote production at Banca d'Italia. Quality, environment, safety and security in the printing process

detail: Danmarks Nationalbank's own cash-supply page states it entered a 2018 contract with Oberthure Fiduciaire in France on the printing of Danish banknotes, that this agreement has since expired, and that it has made a new agreement with 'the British banknote producer, De La Rue' for the upcoming banknote series launching in 2028.

Norges Bank's own page on the notes states that the 2016-2019 banknotes 'were printed by Oberthur Fiduciaire in France' and that 'From 2020, the printing will be carried out by Crane NXT in Malta, while banknote paper is produced in Sweden.' Printing takes place at Crane NXT's Malta facility.
